Equivalence applies only to the named dimension. Missing evidence is unknown. Differences describe observations, not different root causes or a localized cause.

Failure placed on: side A
Every check with a final FAIL has a non-FAIL outcome on side B, so final FAIL outcomes occur only on side A. This does not locate the cause on that side or exclude an endpoint-specific cause.
Evidence: target_tcp

Ambiguous: the two runs do not identify one unique cause.
  Possible: side A's own network state
  Possible: side A's path to the endpoint
  Possible: endpoint-specific failure, including different servers behind the same name or different treatment by address or policy
  Possible: the endpoint or the path changing between the two runs

Caveats:
  The two runs were captured 15 minutes apart, so anything that changed in between is inside the evidence.
  1 check did not produce a measured outcome on both machines and was not read.
